inspiration.observed_pattern: DAYOFMONTH extracts the final day number after month-start date arithmetic.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to independently authored mixed DATE rows with both the derived month-end value and DAYOFMONTH projection, retaining row-dependent date evaluation and NULL propagation.

fixture_notes: A valid February DATE followed by a NULL DATE must produce 2024-02-29/29 then NULL/NULL.
determinism_notes: The two fixed rows and arithmetic intervals are fixed with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE month_end_min (row_id INT PRIMARY KEY, anchor_date DATE NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT row_id, DATE_SUB(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(YEAR(anchor_date), '-', MONTH(anchor_date), '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS month_end, DAYOFMONTH(DATE_SUB(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(YEAR(anchor_date), '-', MONTH(anchor_date), '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS month_end_day FROM month_end_min ORDER BY row_id
